runtime_candidate: ClerkDomainTransactions through existing createConfiguredHttpHandler, createClerkCandidateHandler, StudentHttpRows and StaffFirstTestRows

required_schema_review.people.telegram_id: Nullable; uniqueness for non-null verified Telegram identities. Never coerce null to0 or invent identity linking.
required_schema_review.people.registered_at_ms: Roster review proposal only: immutable original registration timestamp. Existing actual column/data unknown; do not derive from latest login or guess/backfill history.
required_schema_review.student_families.auth_provider: Explicit clerk/telegram provenance. Current code denies an unmarked active family. No automatic legacy attribution.
security_integrity: Canonical issuer+subject unique mapping and immutable person binding
Composite person/family/identity/SID constraints prevent cross-person binding
Deferred active Clerk-family-to-F1-binding requirement allows family+binding insertion within one transaction but never missing at COMMIT
One nonrevoked student family per person; old families revoked before new insert
Global replay digest uniqueness survives person-scoped visibility
SID retirement, refresh consumed, access superseded and first revocation are monotonic
Runtime has no DELETE for auth/replay/provenance/history; retention GC is a separate reviewed scope
domain_integrity: Membership anchor and epoch are person scoped; grants cannot outlive the current epoch
Attempt/series FKs and initial circular references need reviewed deferred constraints
Frozen published snapshot, deadline and generation immutable outside existing explicit transitions
Answer revision CAS, ordinary exact result and command receipt commit atomically

rls_context_review.identity_bootstrap: Only exact verified issuer+subject or verified Telegram identity may locate/create its canonical person before a person row exists. Advisory identity gate precedes person lock. Locator hints are rechecked after locks.
rls_context_review.person_rows: People, membership, family, proof digest, replay, attempts/answers/results/receipts limited to the locked canonical people. WITH CHECK must also prevent person/family/key reassignment.
rls_context_review.staff_rows: Current server-loaded role/approval/capability/group/subject records are used on every command and receipt replay. Actor+target hints are not authorization. Staff liveness remains per provider session; no student device fence for staff.
rls_context_review.private_resources: Group/version and private content access require existing command scope before private projections. Teacher approved-subject content and Admin A assignment rules remain as before.
rls_context_review.roles_and_exposure: Private schema not publicly exposed. No anon/authenticated access to internal auth tables, no service_role/BYPASSRLS shortcut, no user_metadata role trust. Any privileged locator helper/search_path/grants require separate review; none created here.
rls_context_review.limitations: GUC values and parameterized WHERE predicates are defense-in-depth design, not proof that RLS exists or is effective. Actual role privileges, RLS recursion/bootstrap and connection reset need real Postgres tests.

pool_review.named_prepared_statements: Internal Statement.name labels are stripped before node-postgres; no named statements on transaction pooling
pool_review.session_state: SET LOCAL-equivalent set_config(...,true) inside each transaction; no reliance on a warm connection
pool_review.commit_uncertainty: 503, discard connection, no automatic retry or ACK; reconcile by authoritative state and existing idempotency contract
